notes.title: Jan, '25 Update
notes.content:
[h1]25.01.08:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Voice Actors are being added! Check out the Credits screen to see who they are!
[*] When did Nocturnal become a bartender? Check him out in the sewers to find out!
[*] Talbert is hungry. Go have lunch with him?
[*] Zorro can now cook meals for two, like for a date, with your husbando of choice. Especially if you like making sure your date is well fed!
[/list]
[h1]Previously:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Spending an hour with Blade/Goliath no longer takes energy away.
[*] Vamp is missing his poppet. Perhaps you should go train with him.
[*] What's Vamp doing at Aero's Junk? He might show up while you're working. He's looking mighty pent up...
[*] Bloodthirster joins the CV Arena! He knows a secret special room you may be interested in.
[*] There's a secret new room in the CV Arena. What's in store for you?
[*] Rok has some new stuff to say downtown.
[*] You can now meet Rok while working for Boss during the day. Word is he has some special training for you.
[*] After training with Rok, Goliath and Blade now have a new way for you to travel!
[/list]
